w1-sensors.title: Keep sensor characteristics distinct

nodes.label: Sensor reading
nodes.detail: Describe what the measurement can and cannot tell you.

nodes.label: Accuracy
nodes.detail: Agreement with the reference value.

nodes.label: Resolution
nodes.detail: Smallest input change the sensor can distinguish.

nodes.label: Range
nodes.detail: Lowest and highest measurable input.

nodes.label: Sensitivity
nodes.detail: Output change for a unit input change.

w1-sensors.caption: A very fine resolution does not by itself guarantee accurate measurements.

w11-rfid.title: Battery and transmitter are different questions

nodes.label: RFID tag
nodes.detail: Ask how it gets power and how it sends a response.

nodes.label: Passive
nodes.detail: Reader-powered; replies by backscatter.

nodes.label: Semi-passive
nodes.detail: Battery powers the IC; still replies by backscatter.

nodes.label: Active
nodes.detail: Battery-powered with an active transmitter; beacon/transponder examples.

w11-rfid.caption: An onboard battery alone does not distinguish semi-passive from active transmission.

w3-ai.title: AI contains machine learning; ML contains deep learning

nodes.label: Artificial intelligence
nodes.detail: Broad field of machine reasoning and intelligent behaviour.

nodes.label: Machine learning
nodes.detail: A subset of AI that learns patterns or behaviour from data/experience.

nodes.label: Deep learning
nodes.detail: A subset of ML based on multi-layer neural networks.

w3-ai.caption: The hierarchy goes AI → ML → DL. Reversing ML and DL makes the true/false statements incorrect.

w8-cloud-models.title: Rent infrastructure, a platform, or finished software

nodes.label: IaaS
nodes.detail: Provider supplies infrastructure; customer manages its software stack.

nodes.label: PaaS
nodes.detail: Provider supplies a platform; customer develops/configures its application.

nodes.label: SaaS
nodes.detail: Provider supplies a finished application for the customer to use.

w8-cloud-models.caption: The service boundary determines what the provider and customer manage; cloud does not always mean “provider manages everything”.

w9-r.title: R operators: match the symbol to its job

nodes.label: R expression
nodes.detail: Similar-looking operators do different things.
Sequence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
Remainder: 1.
Exponentiation: 8.

nodes.label: TRUE -> C
nodes.detail: Assign TRUE to C.

nodes.label: a & b
nodes.detail: Elementwise logical AND.

w9-r.caption: The sequence operator is :, not &. %% is remainder, while %/% is integer division.

w8-ml.title: Start with the learning task

nodes.label: Training information
nodes.detail: What target or feedback does the system receive?

nodes.label: Supervised
nodes.detail: Known targets: classification for categories, regression for numbers.

nodes.label: Unsupervised
nodes.detail: No target labels: find clusters or structure.

nodes.label: Reinforcement
nodes.detail: Choose actions and learn from reward feedback.

w8-ml.caption: SVM is the classification example; clustering is unsupervised; a real-number target suggests regression.

w6-gas-principle.title: Gas sensing: compare the response with a baseline

nodes.label: Air baseline
nodes.detail: Measure resistance before target-gas exposure.

nodes.label: Gas exposure
nodes.detail: A heated MOS sensing surface interacts with the gas.

nodes.label: Resistance change
nodes.detail: Compare the response against baseline conditions.

nodes.label: Interpret response
nodes.detail: Sensitivity measures change per input; selectivity distinguishes gases.

w6-gas-principle.caption: Baseline, sensitivity and selectivity name different aspects of the measurement.

w5-viewpoints.title: An IIRA activity has four descriptors

nodes.label: Trigger
nodes.detail: The event or condition that initiates the activity.

nodes.label: Workflow
nodes.detail: The steps taken to perform it.

nodes.label: Effect
nodes.detail: The state after successful completion.

nodes.label: Constraints
nodes.detail: Limits or conditions on how the activity may run.

w5-viewpoints.caption: This lists activity descriptors; constraints apply throughout rather than only after the effect.
